# Start here: AI Engineering

English · [Русский](../ru/start/engineering.md) · ← [AI Interview Atlas](../../README.md)

The priority questions of this track, in study order. Answer each one aloud before you read anything: the theme page behind every question adds what a strong answer covers and what to read.

- **1. Derive scaled dot-product attention and explain how its scale affects softmax gradients.**
  - Knowledge · [LLM fundamentals](../themes/llm-fundamentals.md)
- **2. Derive the memory required by a decoder's KV cache as batch size and context length grow.**
  - Knowledge · [LLM fundamentals](../themes/llm-fundamentals.md) · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †, [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †
- **3. Compare multi-head, multi-query and grouped-query attention in quality and serving memory.**
  - Knowledge · [LLM fundamentals](../themes/llm-fundamentals.md) · Asked at: [Meta](../companies/meta.md) †
- **4. Under a fixed training compute budget, how do Chinchilla-style scaling results change the balance between model size and training tokens?**
  - Knowledge · [LLM fundamentals](../themes/llm-fundamentals.md) · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
- **5. How would you test and reduce a model's tendency to miss relevant evidence in the middle of a long context?**
  - Knowledge · [LLM fundamentals](../themes/llm-fundamentals.md)
- **6. Contrast prefill with autoregressive decode and explain when compute or memory bandwidth becomes the bottleneck.**
  - Knowledge · [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md)
- **7. Explain iteration-level batching and how requests enter and leave a running inference batch.**
  - Knowledge · [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md) · Asked at: [Anthropic](../companies/anthropic.md) †
- **8. Explain exact speculative decoding, its acceptance step and workloads where the draft model adds overhead instead of speed.**
  - Knowledge · [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md)
- **9. Estimate a serving memory budget for a 70-billion-parameter model, explicitly choosing precision, context and concurrency assumptions.**
  - Applied scenario · [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md)
- **10. You are asked to reduce serving cost by an order of magnitude. Rank the levers and explain how you would test whether that target is achievable.**
  - Applied scenario · [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md) · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †, [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) †
- **11. After a deployment, p99 latency doubles although model weights are unchanged. How do you isolate the cause?**
  - Applied scenario · [Inference, serving and cost](../themes/inference-economics.md) · Asked at: [Amazon](../companies/amazon.md) †, [Databricks](../companies/databricks.md) †, [OpenAI](../companies/openai.md) †, [Perplexity](../companies/perplexity.md) †
- **12. Choose a chunking approach for technical documentation, including how you preserve meaning across section boundaries.**
  - Applied scenario · [RAG and retrieval](../themes/rag-retrieval.md)
- **13. When would you combine lexical and dense retrieval, and how would you merge their rankings?**
  - Knowledge · [RAG and retrieval](../themes/rag-retrieval.md) · Asked at: [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) †, [Perplexity](../companies/perplexity.md) †
- **14. How would you separately evaluate document retrieval and answer generation in a RAG application?**
  - Applied scenario · [RAG and retrieval](../themes/rag-retrieval.md)
- **15. Design retrieval that enforces the source system's access rights, including permission changes and shared caches.**
  - System design · [RAG and retrieval](../themes/rag-retrieval.md) · Asked at: [Databricks](../companies/databricks.md) †, [Microsoft](../companies/microsoft.md) †, [Palantir](../companies/palantir.md) †
- **16. Compare exact search, HNSW and IVF-PQ for an embedding index under memory, recall and latency constraints.**
  - Knowledge · [RAG and retrieval](../themes/rag-retrieval.md)
- **17. What does interleaving reasoning with tool observations add to a language-model agent compared with reasoning alone?**
  - Knowledge · [Agents, tools and protocols](../themes/agents-tools.md)
- **18. Design recovery from tool errors and timeouts, including cases where a timed-out call may already have changed external state.**

- **19. How would you select, name and document tools so that a model chooses the right operation and arguments?**
